name: Koyeb Free Instance (Legacy Starter Only)
free_limit: Existing Starter-plan organizations only: one Free web instance with 512 MB RAM, 0.1 vCPU and 2 GB SSD
watch_out: Not available as a free signup for new users: Koyeb's February 17, 2026 announcement requires new registrations to choose Pro or another paid plan and provide a payment method. Existing Starter organizations retain their free plan; do not treat this as a new-user free tier. Paid plan subscription/overage charges apply; instance regions, scale-to-zero and persistent-volume restrictions still apply.
